goal: A small, honest, easy-to-inspect professional reference for coordinating evidence-based AI and organizational work, without disclosing private platform IP.
profile_context: The owner seeks cross-corporate project/program and transformation assignments including AI. These repositories can demonstrate concrete technical judgment and evidence discipline, not establish unverified CV achievements.

actions.action: Create an offline regression suite covering strict versus fenced JSON, bool versus number, duplicate JSON keys/attempt cells/config IDs, tampered fingerprints, missing matrix cells, execution failures, partial timings/costs, boundary failure, CLI and local-runner loopback/no-redirect/request capture behavior with mocks.
actions.acceptance: 27 repeat records on 9 cases remain 9 distinct cases; missing evidence never establishes sample eligibility. All attempts including failures retained.

actions.action: Add a decision narrative for the synthetic comparison, a reproducibility check for saved examples, and a precise protocol for a future independent task-specific real comparison (frozen development/holdout split, all attempts, conditions and human effort). Assess whether a small real run with already installed models is feasible without downloads; if collected, label the mixed synthetic-task/measured-response provenance accurately.
actions.acceptance: Never substitute illustrative timing or costs for measurements. A real run on public authored cases is a smoke run, not a held-out benchmark or general model ranking. No mandatory live calls in default tests or CI.

actions.action: Probe grader and CLI for plausible false-positive acceptance and input-overwrite defects before implementing repairs, including huge numeric input and demo --save-run aliasing benchmark/report.
actions.acceptance: False-positive sample eligibility prevented; invalid data yields a structured exit 2, not an unhandled exception; output paths cannot overwrite inputs.

actions.action: Put one safe offline command and a concise expected result near the top; link a readable saved report and a reproducible case study.
actions.acceptance: A reader can understand purpose, run command, expected verdict and limits in the first screen.

actions.action: Add a runnable standard-library JSON report consumer with fail-closed structural checks, distinct error/negative/unknown/sample-met outcomes, tests and an explicit no-action-authority output.
actions.acceptance: Exit 0 only for structurally consistent declared sample eligibility, exit 1 for negative/unknown, exit 2 for invalid/error reports. No exit status grants action authority; no source authenticity or underlying-data recomputation is performed.

actions.action: Use Markdown links in llms.txt, consistent license-pending wording and a prominent modest cross-reference to all three independent showcases; maintain AGENTS.md and project-local showcase.json.
actions.acceptance: No invented interoperability standard, purchase permission, software integration or production claim.

actions.action: Add offline CI for Python 3.11 and 3.13 with core/CLI/consumer tests and deterministic example reproduction; no MCP interface exists here.
actions.acceptance: No model or credentials required in default CI; read-only token permissions; local test counts and skipped tests reported honestly.

actions.action: Describe the demonstrated work: requirements, explicit decision rules, evidence boundaries, implementation and responsible next steps. Add short support/contribution/security guidance and maintenance scope.
actions.acceptance: No unverified CV achievements, customer outcomes, enterprise readiness or commercial demand claims.

actions.action: Keep license unselected; document the owner decisions needed for noncommercial/research/procurement use and future commercial terms. Do not create a LICENSE, checkout, release, price or visibility change.
actions.acceptance: No implicit free-use or redistribution grant and no claim that source availability is open source.

action: Protect bundled benchmark, explicit inputs and save-run/report paths from collisions.
Handle huge numeric values without an uncaught OverflowError.
Reject an impossible distinct-case minimum greater than benchmark size.
Complete cost observations with zero accepted responses fail a required cost gate; the undefined ratio stays null.
Explain that unknown local costs prevent eligibility only if a cost ceiling is required; never relax the frozen policy after observing outcomes.
Add offline tests, defensive consumer, frozen future evaluation protocol and a bounded measured smoke capture.
actions.acceptance: Regression tests reproduce the original defects and exercise the repaired behavior; all input files remain byte-identical after refused collisions.

actions.action: Repair the Python 3.11/3.12 floating-point aggregate discrepancy exposed by the first GitHub example replay; use explicit stable accumulation.
actions.acceptance: A focused regression fails before the repair. Stored examples reproduce under both locally available versions; original responses, frozen policy and sample verdicts remain unchanged.

actions.action: Present the existing measured capture as a completed decision case, with question, requirements, all failures, limits, proposed accountability and offline replay. Link it for humans and agents.
actions.acceptance: Existing 18 measured attempts and all evidence bytes unchanged. No automatic winner; no cost or human-effort inference; no new model in the reference case.

pre_edit_gate: Record baseline tests and one independent Gemini 3.8 Flash review of this plan and supplied source before repository edits. Revise actions against concrete findings.
publication_gate: Separate evidence for any real customer, commercial or production claim
reference_interpretation: Adopt visible examples, short reproducible entry points, tests and explicit agent guidance. These sources do not prove why users award stars or validate this owner's competence.

review.filesystem_protection: All three repository directories mounted read-only for reviewer process.
review.review_scope: One plan/source-packet review, not execution or independent source authentication.

accepted: Protect bundled benchmark, explicit inputs and save-run/report paths from collisions.
Handle huge numeric values without an uncaught OverflowError.
Reject an impossible distinct-case minimum greater than benchmark size.
Complete cost observations with zero accepted responses fail a required cost gate; the undefined ratio stays null.
Explain that unknown local costs prevent eligibility only if a cost ceiling is required; never relax the frozen policy after observing outcomes.
Add offline tests, defensive consumer, frozen future evaluation protocol and a bounded measured smoke capture.
rejected_or_bounded: The reviewer example demo --benchmark is not a valid CLI invocation; the bundled-fixture collision is nevertheless reproduced separately.
Do not add tests before the pre-edit gate; baseline absence of a suite and adversarial probes were recorded first.
No MCP adapter/job for llm-eval; it has no MCP interface.
Do not replace retained failed attempts with an early silent abort or successful retries.

The supplied benchmark actually sets maximum_cost_per_accepted_eur to null. The review claim that default local runs necessarily lack cost-required evidence is incorrect. Retain the original pre-collection policy (p95 <= 3.0 seconds; no required cost ceiling).
limits: One source-packet plan review; reviewer did not execute tests. Helper implementations and some fixtures were outside the packet; findings were checked against the actual source.
AGY was requested with selector gemini-3.8-flash-high; no independent attestation of the backend model.

The original textual review ended inside its final limits section and was not valid complete JSON. Its substantive findings and verdict were available; the original missing wording was not reconstructed. See the separately dated continuation record.

review_continuation.scope: Continuation of original source-packet review; not a new stress test or review of implemented changes.
review_continuation.reviewer_statement: No substantive findings, blockers or plan changes were omitted by truncation.
review_continuation.adjudication: Completed scope limits are consistent with the recorded review. No code or implementation-plan changes required; no verbatim recovery claimed.

reference_case_finalization.pre_edit_stress: Baseline tests, byte-identical stored-capture replay and unchanged tracked hashes verified before edits. Prior AGY review and recovered continuation remain documented separately.
reference_case_finalization.scope: Documentation only: decision brief and navigation. Freeze all evidence files, source code, fixtures, benchmark and sample verdicts. No new models or measurements in the reference.
reference_case_finalization.rights: Owner decision pending; no license grant.
